bluf: LawRank is a founder led law firm marketing agency (co-founder Mariano Rodriguez) that works only with attorneys, selling SEO first, with PPC, Local Services Ads, web design and an AI optimization line, to injury, family and criminal defense practices. The record shows it moving the pitch to AI answers: an AIO page on entity authority and mention rate tracking, LinkedIn ads offering a free AI mention check, and an llms.txt on its own site. Horus reads it Neutral at 7; Monsoon reads Landfall at 74.8 with displacement 80.8. The one thing a rival should know: its two case studies are dated 2021-01-18 and 4 of its 10 named clients are names only.
doing:
The positioning line, a law firm marketing agency that works only with attorneys, pairing SEO with PPC, web design and AI optimization to win more cases, decodes to a single vertical search shop for small practices with exclusivity as the hook: the homepage asks firms to check whether a spot is open in their market. The headline claim, first time calls up 384% within 12 months, is the agency's claim and the record ties it to no named firm.

The sold mix leads with SEO (score 3: the SEO page cites clients ranking for big city injury terms). Core at score 2: AI Search / GEO (an AIO page on entity authority, AI citable content and mention rate tracking; the meta names AI optimization), Paid Search (a PPC page as a certified Google Partner with ROI tracking; Local Services Ads for lawyers in the nav) and Web & Product (an attorney web design page and portfolio; a testimonial credits a site redesign). Data & Measurement, CRO, Paid Social and AI Automation score 0. Family scores: Search & AI visibility 2.9, Experience & build 1.3, Performance media 0.97, Data & measurement 0. The record lists no proprietary product and one partner, Google Partner.

AI posture: AI optimization sold inside SEO, with LinkedIn ads asking whether AI mentions the firm when a client asks for the best attorney in its city.

Recent moves: the record lists none and no news; the two case studies, Lavent Law and Mission Personal Injury Lawyers, are dated 2021-01-18 and were last modified 2026-09-07, and the blog carries no recent dates.

Pricing signals: PPC is sold on short term contracts and the homepage sells market exclusivity, but the record lists no pricing model. Conspicuously absent: a head office city, a founding year, an employee count, jobs or an ATS (jobs count 0), any data and measurement line under the 384% claim, and any case study newer than 2021.
clients:
The client type is SMB law firms: the verticals are Personal injury law, Family law and divorce and Criminal defense law; the record lists no office, so the home market is the US by region only. The services page shows a 4.8 Google rating from 103 reviews.

The needs read names 10 clients, 6 observed and 4 names only, none shared with another tracked agency. Rosenbaum Personal Injury Lawyers, McMinn Personal Injury Lawyers, Shaked Law and Schultz & Myers Personal Injury Lawyers are logos on the SEO services page, coded organic demand from that placement alone. Lavent Law came for organic demand and lead generation (2021-01-18: traffic up 2,200% and leads doubled with SEO, as the excerpt claims); Mission Personal Injury Lawyers for lead generation (2021-01-18: leads up 300%). The mix read: local and lead generation 0.6, organic demand 0.4.

The 4 names only are testimonials from attorneys in their public role: David J. Muñoz (personal injury, San Diego), Stephen Hasner (personal injury, Atlanta), Todd Lasky (personal injury, Philadelphia) and Hossein Berenji (family law, Los Angeles); one testimonial credits a site redesign, but the read codes no need, so what they came for is inferred from the sold mix. The deepen pass counted 2 case studies: the newest dated work is from 2021.

What the base needs next, tied to KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers): very likely, moderate confidence, these injury and family practices need AI mention share in their city and Local Services Ads managed against cost per signed case, which the sold mix already covers; likely, low confidence, the logo clients on the SEO page are the accounts a rival with dated results can contest first.
house: Say and do: 3 of 3 tested lines pass and the Radar flags no gaps. AI Search / GEO corroborated (llms.txt published, 5 AI topic URLs in a 369 URL sitemap); Paid Search corroborated (its Transparency Center record shows 23 ads, 9 in the last 30 days, 10 text, 9 image and 4 video, advertiser LawRank, LLC, last shown 2026-09-27, no sample lines captured); publishing cadence corroborated on 2 URLs updated in 90 days and 4 in 365, slow for a content and link building seller. The tag stack is eight deep: GTM, GA4, a Google Ads tag, a Meta pixel, LinkedIn Insight, HubSpot, Hotjar and Dealfront Leadfeeder (an ABM stack entry) on WordPress; no test tools; no AI crawlers blocked. LinkedIn: 8 company page ads, all 8 matching the name query, with the line "When potential clients ask AI who the best attorney is in your city does it mention you? Get a free" AI mention check.
market:

Best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation (net 0.292, AI Search / GEO driving), and KJ2, ads inside AI answers (net 0.292). openings:
The strongest opening is price against dated proof: displacement 80.8 on the Monsoon read, SEO and web hours an offshore delivered rival can undercut line by line, no public pricing (P5 unknown), and two case studies dated 2021-01-18 behind the 384% claim. It is likely, moderate confidence, that a rival with dated 2026 injury firm results, priced on signed cases, takes the four logo clients on its SEO page (Rosenbaum, McMinn, Shaked, Schultz & Myers). Falsifier: new case studies dated after 2026-09-28 on lawrank.com with named firms and figures, or a published price.

Its AI line is the one to attack with a product: P1 is partial, mention rate tracking is sold but no audited citation share product shows, so a rival that publishes the audited number for a city and practice area very likely leads the AI conversation, and its own LinkedIn ad hands over the script. P8 is absent, so the first legal agency to show results from ads inside assistants sets the price.

Where it is strong, a rival should not lead: P2 and P3 are making and 3 of 3 house tests pass. The exclusivity hook (one spot per market) is a roughly even chance to hold, low confidence: the record shows no count of markets or firms.
watch: I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: outcome pricing at a top five holdco would set a public benchmark its unknown P5 has to answer and deepen the KJ6 exposure on its SEO and PPC hours.

I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the SEO lead line; above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the next milestone ($2B) and pricing below $20 CPM would open the KJ2 channel where its P8 is absent.
Follow the Lavent Law and Mission Personal Injury Lawyers case studies (dated 2021-01-18, last modified 2026-09-07): a refreshed or new study would be the first dated result on the book since 2021.
